pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, sub-polygonal dark regions with softened edge gradients. The transition from dark to light pelage occurs over a narrow pixel band, creating a non-sharp boundary. Patches are significantly larger in relative surface area compared to the separating network.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, interconnected lattice of light-toned pelage. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-radial and quadri-radial intersections. The corridors maintain a relatively consistent pixel-width across the visible flank, forming a clear topological graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the dorsal neck displays a consistent jagged silhouette. The profile consists of high-frequency, low-amplitude protrusions of dark hair visible against the light-colored background.
